text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Countless top racers have gathered here
at Tokyo
Racecourse in Fuchu! But only
one gets to take
home the trophy!
Ladies and gentlemen, the
autumn
Tenno Sho will begin shortly!
...Allow me to see what you're made of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'd like to say before
the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you watch closely, and witness
the
instance in which all the moments
we've shared
come together to shatter
the preordained
outcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I shall do my best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The journey has been long, and yet it
also feels
as brief as a moment.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(My heart holds more moments
still—more
moments than there are stars
in the sky.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Those vivid and dazzling days my
precious rivals
gifted me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Wonderful memories of the races in
which we
surpassed our limits
together...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I shall turn each and every one of these
moments
into the shining light of my
current self.)
